title: 第5章 气运之子第6章 简简单单
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
送沈雪见回到住处后，陆沉恋恋不舍地回到自己的房间。
随即急不可耐地问道：“苟系统，我的奖励呢？那个抽奖机会是什么情况？”
“现在想起我了？刚才和小姑娘有说有笑的时候怎么没想起我来呢？”
9527翻了翻白眼吐槽道。
“废话少说，快给我解释一下抽奖是什么？”
陆沉催促道。
“这个嘛，顾名思义，就是抽奖咯！”
“你好像在说废话。”
“你问的就是废话！”
一人一统针锋相对。
“行行行，那我问你抽奖都有什么奖品？”
“我也不知道，运气好的话说不定能抽到什么上古神器，运气差的话说不定能抽到什么危险的东西。
我也是第一次接触这个，你要不要试试看？”
苟系统一脸坏笑地看着陆沉。
陆沉毕竟只是个十岁的孩子，哪里有那么多心思，全部注意力都集中在“上古神器”
这四个字上，后面的话是一个字都没听进去。
“我要抽，快给我抽奖！”
陆沉催促道。
“OK！
如你所愿！”

屏幕上出现一个被分成十几份的大转盘，每一份颜色和大小都不一样。
大转盘飞速地转动起来，陆沉全身心地盯着它，眼神里满是激动，而苟系统则是在一旁像是看热闹不嫌事大的样子，心里想着：“小伙子，就让你看看社会的险恶，前世那些游戏公司的大转盘可都是收割韭菜的利器，不抽到保底是不可能给你出好东西的！”
在转了无数圈后，那大转盘的速度明显降了下来，逐渐开始停下来。
看着指针马上就要停在白色区域时，9527的嘴角已经忍不住上扬起来，心里已经将接下来嘲讽的词语都准备好了。
然而，那原本就要停下的指针，居然硬生生地越过了那么大一片白色区域，在旁边极窄的金色区域停了下来，当场金光乍现。
苟系统当场石化在原地，无能狂怒地吼道：“什么鬼？爆金了？”
9527心里默默盘算着：“难道这小鬼是什么气运之子？嗯，一定是这样，有系统，又有逆天的运气，还能机缘巧合下结识大美女，这不是妥妥的主角模板吗？凭什么他就能当主角，而我连投胎都能出问题？天啊，为什么要这样折磨我？”
“苟系统，你想什么呢？快看看这是个什么玩意儿？”
陆沉指着面前的一口黑色的大鼎说道。
9527闻言回过神来，也是好奇地打量着那足足有一五高的黑色圆鼎：“这就是你爆的金？看起来也没什么特别的嘛！”
“你也不知道这是什么？天天吹你那有好东西，结果拿个破烂来糊弄我？”
陆沉一脸鄙夷地看着苟系统，眼中满是嫌弃。
“怎，怎么可能，我怎么会糊弄你呢！
这鼎绝对是好东西，你等会儿。”
content_en:
After sending Shen Xuejian back to his residence, Lu Chen reluctantly returned to his room.
Then he asked impatiently: "Gou System, where is my reward? What's the status of the lottery opportunity?"
"You think of me now? Why didn't you think of me when you were talking and laughing with the little girl just now?"
9527 rolled his eyes and complained.
"Stop talking nonsense and explain to me what the lottery is?"
Lu Chen urged.
"Well, as the name suggests, it's a lottery!"
"You seem to be talking nonsense."
"What you asked is nonsense!"
One man, one man, tit for tat.
"Okay, okay, let me ask you what are the prizes in the lottery?"
"I don't know. If you're lucky, you might be able to draw some ancient artifact, and if you're not lucky, you might be able to draw something dangerous.
This is also my first time contacting this. Do you want to give it a try? "
Gou System looked at Lu Chen with a wicked smile.
After all, Lu Chen is only a ten-year-old child. He has so many thoughts and all his attention is focused on the "ancient artifact"
Of these four words, I didn't hear a word of what was said behind them.
"I want to draw, give me a draw now!"
Lu Chen urged.
"OK!
As you wish! "
A large carousel divided into a dozen parts appeared on the screen, each part having a different color and size.
The big turntable turned rapidly. Lu Chen stared at it with all his heart, his eyes full of excitement, while Gou System stood aside as if he was watching the excitement and didn't mind the trouble, thinking to himself: "Young man, let me show you the dangers of society. The big turntables of those game companies in the past life were all sharp tools for harvesting leeks. It is impossible to give you good things without drawing a guarantee!"
After countless turns, the speed of the big turntable dropped significantly and gradually began to stop.
Seeing that the pointer was about to stop in the white area, 9527 could not help but raise the corners of his mouth, and he had already prepared the next sarcastic words in his heart.
However, the pointer that was about to stop unexpectedly crossed such a large white area and stopped in the extremely narrow golden area next to it, and a golden light suddenly appeared on the spot.
Gou System was petrified on the spot, and he yelled incompetently and furiously: "What the hell? Got a lot of money?"
9527 silently thought in his mind: "Is this kid the son of luck? Well, it must be like this. He has a system, and he has incredible luck, and he can meet a beautiful woman by chance. Isn't this a perfect protagonist template? Why can he be the protagonist, and I can even have problems with my reincarnation? God, why are you torturing me like this?"
"Gou System, what are you thinking about? Come and see what this thing is?"
Lu Chen pointed at the big black cauldron in front of him and said.
9527 came back to his senses after hearing this, and curiously looked at the black round tripod that was about one to five meters tall: "Is this the gold you made? It doesn't look like anything special!"
"You don't know what this is? You brag about your good stuff every day, but you end up fooling me with a rag?"
Lu Chen looked at Gou System with disdain, his eyes full of disgust.
"How, how is it possible, how could I fool you!
This cauldron is definitely a good thing, just wait a moment. "
